proof_boundaries.source_facts: Each own manual/datasheet page and selected SDK member is bound to exact indexed bytes; equality of native layout is corroboration, never cross-family hardware authority.
proof_boundaries.sram_copy: Finite count 1..65535, equal widths, REPEAT=1, BLOCK; complete extents/alignment/non-overlap must fit each exact 8 KiB SRAM region.
proof_boundaries.success: Recorded own TC, no TE, STATUS=5; software copy additionally requires SOFTSRC=0. TE wins over TC. A later favorable snapshot does not cure inconsistent completion.
proof_boundaries.unresolved_lifetime: No stop, error, request closure, reset, clock-off or timeout establishes bus drain. Error or unresolved cancellation retains/quarantines the physical channel and static storage permanently.
proof_boundaries.staged_uart_tx: Caller bytes are CPU-copied into owned SRAM staging. DMA EN precedes DMATX. Clean DMA completion permits staging reuse; TXBUSY=0 additionally establishes wire drain in the documented protocol.
proof_boundaries.shared_vector: CH2/CH3 share DMACH23 but retain independent descriptors, flags, owners and waiters. CH4 uses independent DMACH4.
proof_boundaries.generic_aliases: No exact SRAM metadata means safe admission remains refused; successful compilation alone does not grant admission.
unqualified: RF DMA or RF state access
proof_boundaries.software_verification: Main: six standalone ARM libraries and 21 ELF links, all 27 commands exit zero with zero warnings; seven finite generation/source commands passed in documented segments. Actual independent runtime and metadata reviews accepted main. Clean had not run at main acceptance and requires a separate final-source receipt.
hardware_limits: No error injection or drain timing
No RF traffic or electrical validation

identity_comparison: All fields of each selected source-index node are strict except its evidence consumer list and embedded text.evidence. SDK archive members catalogs are excluded because only the separately bound selected members are in scope; each selected member identity and archive chain is strict. Unknown non-consumer fields are not ignored.

retained_source_gate_failures.cause: Vendor-referenced text nodes have no own id; resolve parent artifact.id while retaining selected-node identity equality.
The clock ledger omits notes/evidence; compare the same explicit projection while preserving all other fields.
Own L052 fields use standard lsb/msb rather than bitOffset/bitWidth; normalize only the two actual complete encodings with strict geometry equality.

checker_source_correspondence.change_after_main: Only the reviewed SVD field-encoding parser correction; no compiled HAL/example, lock, configuration or generated bytes changed. Final source gates passed on the corrected checker. Administrative evidence/status/packaging changes are recorded separately after main.

main_acceptance_boundary.actual_artifact_review: Independent inspection of ARM archive members, actual ELF executable text, reset/Thumb entry, initial stack, allocated/load ranges, exact memory.x, active vector words and strong handler symbols; generic SRAM None and exact package routes inspected in retained generated inputs.
main_acceptance_boundary.clean_at_main_acceptance: Not run. Final-package acceptance requires separate source-only reconstruction, ordinary generation, finite source gates, two standalone ARM libraries, four linked ELFs and independent clean review.
